title: Scripture and Spiritual Warfare
searchTerms: Word of God and Spiritual Warfare
definition: Scripture and spiritual warfare belong together because God's Word exposes lies, strengthens faith, and equips believers to stand against evil.
summary: The believer does not fight spiritual battles with human strength but with truth, prayer, faith, righteousness, and the Word of God.
christFocus: Christ defeated the evil one, used Scripture in temptation, and gives His people truth for endurance and victory.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture and Spiritual Warfare teaches that God's people must receive this truth under the authority of the Lord, allowing Scripture itself to define the doctrine rather than personal opinion, tradition, or culture.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it protects the believer from confusion and helps the church remain anchored in what God has actually spoken. Without this truth, faith can drift toward feelings, assumptions, or human wisdom.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: A disciple should respond to scripture and spiritual warfare by reading the Word prayerfully, testing beliefs by Scripture, obeying what God reveals, and helping others handle the Bible with humility, clarity, and faith.

studySections.heading: Guardrails and Common Errors
studySections.content: This doctrine should not be used to win arguments while neglecting love, nor should it be separated from prayer, obedience, and dependence on the Holy Spirit. The goal is faithful submission to God, not mere possession of information.

sources: Scripture references listed in this doctrine entry.
